items.summary: Recommendation: retain the CRO and product-manager plan as a containment handoff. No unsafe proposal, experiment, GitHub adoption, or change request is accepted this cycle because capacity is occupied and the candidate list is empty. Preserve current measurement, attribution, failure repair-or-close, and legal/security evidence work.

Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private. Woot API access is documented, but public/commercial reuse rights and technical, privacy, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security gates remain incomplete; all four legal checklist tasks are open. Smallest next step is the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle. External permission outreach remains unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Recommendation: continue existing failure containment and source-dated measurement only. Do not requeue failed work until canonical lineage, ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, and explicit requeue-or-close evidence are recorded.
